svg.title: How it works: Meta's models propose and code decides. Before the job, Muse Spark reads the plate and Muse Wonder the manual, and code checks both into a card. During the job, Muse Spark guides, boxes the part for SAM 3.1, and Muse Voice listens; G0 and the rule engine can stop. Whether a step is done is decided in code from the judge and a second witness. With no connection, Muse Glimmer runs locally.
svg.text: O or 0 is one tap; no serial
guides, a sentence at a time
that sends you to a red zone
a gas smell, an alarm, fire
Muse Glimmer on your own GPU
guide, judge, locate, plate and manual, through ollama, after two failed API calls; optical flow is the witness
